description: This file defines the InterviewAttachmentDecorator class in the OrangeHRM project. It acts as a decorator for the InterviewAttachment entity, providing methods to retrieve file content and associate interviews by ID. It utilizes traits for ORM helpers and manipulates attachment data streams.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for InterviewAttachment entity, providing helper methods to access file content and associate interview entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an InterviewAttachment object.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of the attachment, converting resource streams to string if necessary.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachment
methods.description: Protected accessor for the associated InterviewAttachment entity.

methods.name: setInterviewById
methods.description: Associates an Interview entity with the attachment by its ID.
